SELECT
	S.QuantityBalance AS N

	AccumulationRegister.Stock.Balance(&P, (Item) = &P2) AS S

results.name: dcs_optional_join
platformExpandedQueries:
SELECT
	1 AS N
FROM
	Catalog.Товары AS T

results.name: dcs_optional_join_used
platformExpandedQueries:
SELECT
	U.Code AS N
FROM
	Catalog.Товары AS T
